# Changelog — Core Layer

This changelog summarizes notable updates to the `Core_Layer` document. Entries are short human-written summaries of changes.

- 2026-08-17 — Canonicalized `Core_Layer.md`: clarified that the repository physical layout is `Prismata/Projects/Applications`, `Prismata/Projects/Services`, `Prismata/Projects/Tooling`. Supersedes earlier wording that implied `Core`/`Infrastructure`/`Tenant` were physical roots.
- 2026-07-23 — Clarified `project_type` mapping to `Applications`/`Services`/`Tooling` and added notes about preferring physical grouping for repository layout and CI paths.
- 2026-06-01 — Initial snapshot: schema, taxonomy, and substrate definitions (conceptual core layer overview).
